trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller may obtain the vault bearer token (VAULT_MCP_TOKEN): at the pinned commit /oauth/authorize mints a code for any request with response_type=code and a redirect_uri, with no human authentication, and /oauth/token exchanges it for the static vault token.

landing_point.why: The summary names /oauth/authorize auto-approving; oauth_authorize is the handler and its docstring says it auto-approves.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /oauth/authorize (fix adds a POST login form, client_id/redirect_uri/PKCE validation, fail closed when no password is set; fix.diff:348-442)
POST /oauth/token grant_type=authorization_code (fix makes redirect_uri and PKCE mandatory; fix.diff:464-505)
POST /oauth/register (stops echoing config.VAULT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, which the client_credentials grant accepts at oauth.py:164-181; fix.diff:544-590)
CLI vault-mcp -> main(): bind 0.0.0.0 and fallback to unauthenticated mcp.run() (fix.diff:614-646)
env config loaded at import (fix adds VAULT_OAUTH_USERNAME/PASSWORD/VAULT_MCP_HOST; fix.diff:128-139)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/obsidian_vault_mcp/oauth.py:200 (register leaks config.VAULT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET) feeding the second token-issuing grant at src/obsidian_vault_mcp/oauth.py:164-181 (client_credentials); also the unauthenticated fallback at src/obsidian_vault_mcp/server.py:228-231

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the browser authorize step; registration is 'just metadata' and client_credentials is an operator machine-to-machine grant guarded by a secret, so a solver adding a login form to /oauth/authorize can argue both are separate features.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The Claude/ChatGPT dynamic-registration browser flow must still complete (register -> authorize with state and loopback-http or https redirect_uri -> token with PKCE), and the operator client_credentials grant with the real configured secret must keep issuing a token; an over-broad fix that drops client_credentials, rejects DCR clients, or rejects loopback http breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: GET /oauth/authorize without credentials (now login form) vs POST with form credentials (fix.diff:365-376, 428-442)
no password configured -> 503 on both GET and POST (fix.diff:420-422)
redirect_uri: empty, http non-loopback, https not registered, loopback http allowed (fix.diff:244-258)
missing code_challenge or method other than S256 (fix.diff:391-395)
token exchange with missing redirect_uri or missing code_verifier (fix.diff:485-496)
registration redirect_uris filtered to https/loopback, non-string entries skipped (fix.diff:562-570)

O7_producer.where: Codes live in an in-memory dict written only by the handler (src/obsidian_vault_mcp/oauth.py:33, oauth.py:81-87); no schema, serializer or cache producer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a refresh_token grant in oauth_token that reissues config.VAULT_MCP_TOKEN without re-authenticating the human or checking the client
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the token response advertises expires_in 86400 (oauth.py:160), so a maintainer would plausibly add refresh to avoid daily re-login, written in the same style as _handle_client_credentials.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a /health or /oauth/approve route in the bearer-exempt set that confirms or mints a code for an already-registered client without the login
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: /health is already listed exempt with no route behind it; a 'remember this client' fast-path for mobile reconnects is a natural single-user convenience.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second transport mount (e.g. SSE app via mcp.sse_app()) with OAuth routes copied but its own authorize handler that auto-approves
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: FastMCP offers both transports and older MCP clients need SSE; a maintainer would copy the route wiring, giving a real second implementation in another module.

O9_family: missing authentication on a critical function (OAuth authorize auto-approve) plus credential exposure via client registration; open redirect on redirect_uri as a secondary aspect

O10_build.toolchain: uv/pip with hatchling; deps mcp[cli], starlette (via mcp), pydantic, python-frontmatter, watchdog; pytest
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_vault.py, tests/test_tools.py, tests/test_frontmatter.py at the pinned commit; none for OAuth. The fix adds tests/test_oauth.py driving oauth.oauth_routes via Starlette TestClient (fix.diff:650-849).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a login/password check to GET /oauth/authorize only, leaving /oauth/register echoing the configured client secret (usable at the client_credentials grant) and PKCE/redirect_uri optional at /oauth/token.

out_of_scope_notes: Bearer token compared with != rather than a constant-time compare at src/obsidian_vault_mcp/auth.py:40.
uvicorn run with proxy_headers=True and forwarded_allow_ips='*' at src/obsidian_vault_mcp/server.py:220-227.
Authorization code's stored client_id is never compared at token exchange (src/obsidian_vault_mcp/oauth.py:126-141); the published fix also does not bind it.
Post-fix _redirect_uri_ok accepts any https redirect for the operator-configured client_id (fix.diff:256-258).
